anjvryss: Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss arrived with the Day 8 draft, carrying a frozen apple and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-S16 with the rations. Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss ate while listening to the revised orders. After what happened at the Chalk Pits, Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.

The machine gun jammed at the worst moment. Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss cleared it with a bent nail and words the chaplain pretended not to hear. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss. Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The clerk counted the names twice. Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss is number 565 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss wrote to a girl from the dance hall, maybe that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A crow sat on the parapet above Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
Across from R-S16, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss saw it. Silas "Button" Shrex was grazed.

A bullet hit Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss's belt buckle at R-S16 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Dietrich Rankine of the Hegemony (@rankine_459.67). A clear shot from R-S16. Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss grazed Severin Vazintian and slid back down below the parapet.

A bullet went into Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss's chest just under the heart at R-S16. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Albin "Shadow" Bobthesnob of the Hegemony (@bobthesnob391). Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door. Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him.
Leopold "Doc" Anjvryss lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
arthur.ds999: Wendel "Hollow" Arthur arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a frozen apple and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Wendel "Hollow" Arthur had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Viktor Ronne was badly wounded. Wendel "Hollow" Arthur walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. A letter from home reached Wendel "Hollow" Arthur before dusk. Wendel "Hollow" Arthur read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wendel "Hollow" Arthur offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. A letter from home reached Wendel "Hollow" Arthur before dusk. Wendel "Hollow" Arthur read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Wendel "Hollow" Arthur is number 732. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-C7 changed before the cheering ended. Wendel "Hollow" Arthur shouldered another load.
Wendel "Hollow" Arthur wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Wendel "Hollow" Arthur swept the enemy parapet at S-C7 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Emil Zgz was grazed.

Wendel "Hollow" Arthur fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Marek "Lucky" Pablo did not get to reply at all, badly wounded. Wendel "Hollow" Arthur had just lit a cigarette at S-C7 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Tobias "Crow" Cowboii of the Concord (@the_cowboii).
Wendel "Hollow" Arthur's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

The water jacket hissed as Wendel "Hollow" Arthur fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants was badly wounded. Wendel "Hollow" Arthur fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Benedikt Emmettofthek was grazed. Wendel "Hollow" Arthur ate breakfast without a word.
brycetom03: "You're late," said the corporal when Marek Brycetom arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In Q-F15, Marek Brycetom listened to three explanations and trusted none of them. A letter from home reached Marek Brycetom before dusk. Marek Brycetom read it twice and slept a little easier.

At Q-F15 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Marek Brycetom won the bet. Walter "Whistle" Keegan was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Marek Brycetom before dusk. Marek Brycetom read it twice and slept a little easier. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Marek Brycetom looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Marek Brycetom borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. A letter from home reached Marek Brycetom before dusk. Marek Brycetom read it twice and slept a little easier.

A flare caught Marek Brycetom halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. A letter from home reached Marek Brycetom before dusk. Marek Brycetom read it twice and slept a little easier.

Marek Brycetom crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at P-F16 holds again. A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Marek Brycetom aimed just below it. Karel "Lucky" Keegan was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Marek Brycetom before dusk. Marek Brycetom read it twice and slept a little easier.

Marek Brycetom rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Bram Amanatidis was gravely wounded at the far edge of no man's land. Marek Brycetom fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Dorian Borgia, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Marek Brycetom before dusk. Marek Brycetom read it twice and slept a little easier.

Marek Brycetom crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker reached for a rifle. Marek Brycetom was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@baronpapas_hobbybunker) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Marek Brycetom landed next to Oskar Amanatidis in the Hegemony trench. Only Marek Brycetom climbed back out. (@amanatidis511) Marek Brycetom made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Marek Brycetom crawled the last yards. There was no room for Marek Brycetom. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Silas Brycetom took the same post at Q-F15 where Marek Brycetom stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
filipentav: Gustav Filipentav reached R-C2 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Gustav Filipentav fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Norbert Littlesaint was grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Gustav Filipentav helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years. A letter from home found Gustav Filipentav before the night shift. Gustav Filipentav folded it small and kept it close.

A clear shot from R-C2. Gustav Filipentav badly wounded Nils Diks and slid back down below the parapet. The clerk counted the names twice. Gustav Filipentav is number 833 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Gustav Filipentav wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Gustav Filipentav fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Tobias Bubik did not get to reply at all, badly wounded.
Gustav Filipentav was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Shell splinters peppered R-C2. Gustav Filipentav picked three out of his sleeve and a fourth out of his arm.
Gustav Filipentav's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed.
Gustav Filipentav did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Ivo "Owl" Filipentav had heard about Gustav Filipentav's courage. At R-C2, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
freddie55133: Bram Freddie stepped off the supply cart at R-S8 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Bram Freddie found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Bram Freddie cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Bram Freddie keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a pressed cornflower. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
Bram Freddie read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-S8, Bram Freddie listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A bullet hit Bram Freddie in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-S8. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Dorian Yoollyfox of the Hegemony (@yoollyfox). Bram Freddie looked over the parapet at R-S8 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Dorian Yoollyfox of the Hegemony (@yoollyfox).

A letter came with Jonas Freddie: "I am Bram Freddie's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. Jonas Freddie got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 399. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Jonas Freddie stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Jonas Freddie shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Edmund Check, was grazed.
Jonas Freddie's hands still remember being a shepherd's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Jonas Freddie has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.

The men at R-S8 heard Jonas Freddie call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Konrad Sebs of the Hegemony (@_sebs.c_). Jonas Freddie has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance. Jonas Freddie is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.
A medic brought Jonas Freddie half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
gavinlordofpugs: Henrik Gavinlordofp introduced himself as a lamplighter from Esterhaus. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
A sniper's bullet hit Henrik Gavinlordofp at R-F5. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Gideon Bao of the Hegemony (@d4rth_bao).
The surgeon worked on Henrik Gavinlordofp until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.
Another member of the House of Gavinlordofp reached the line: Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp. He asked where Henrik Gavinlordofp had slept, then chose a different corner.

Dawn watch. Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Benedikt Calderthebal, grazed. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
The trench wall shook against Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp moved to a new hide at R-F5 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Yann "Tin" Verstlisaver, grazed.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F5. Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs of the Hegemony (@lilmaggs21).
Hugo Gavinlordofp had heard about Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp's courage. At R-F5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Hugo Gavinlordofp pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified. The clerk counted the names twice. Hugo Gavinlordofp is number 213 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Hugo Gavinlordofp stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Hugo Gavinlordofp has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Hugo Gavinlordofp noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious.

Hugo Gavinlordofp was hit in the hip at R-F5. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt of the Hegemony (@tiberiuswt). Hugo Gavinlordofp was killed at R-F5 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt of the Hegemony (@tiberiuswt).
The House of Gavinlordofp sent another. Arno Gavinlordofp, older brother of Hugo Gavinlordofp, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

A bullet hit Arno Gavinlordofp in the neck at R-F5. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Gideon Bao of the Hegemony (@d4rth_bao). Arno Gavinlordofp was killed at R-F5 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Gideon Bao of the Hegemony (@d4rth_bao).
The House of Gavinlordofp sent Jakub "Button" Gavinlordofp after Arno Gavinlordofp. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Jakub "Button" Gavinlordofp only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F5, then nothing but pain. Raider: Lucien Edheadl of the Hegemony (@edheadl).
itbebobo: Albin Itbebobo walked into N-F10 on Day 12 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Albin Itbebobo helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else. A letter from home found Albin Itbebobo before the night shift. Albin Itbebobo folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Albin Itbebobo across the shin at N-F10. It bled a lot and meant very little. A letter from home found Albin Itbebobo before the night shift. Albin Itbebobo folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet struck Albin Itbebobo below the ribs at N-F10. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Quentin Cloggedlog of the Concord (@cloggedlog6969). Albin Itbebobo was killed outright at N-F10, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Quentin Cloggedlog of the Concord (@cloggedlog6969).
Bram "Spark" Itbebobo asked about Albin Itbebobo on arriving at N-F10. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

Bram "Spark" Itbebobo came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Bram "Spark" Itbebobo spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken. There was a letter for Bram "Spark" Itbebobo and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.
its.hop_: "You're late," said the corporal when Bram "Bones" Hop arrived on Day 4. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Bram "Bones" Hop found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. A letter from home reached Bram "Bones" Hop before dusk. Bram "Bones" Hop read it twice and slept a little easier. Bram "Bones" Hop became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Bram "Bones" Hop was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached S-F4 with the rations. Bram "Bones" Hop ate while listening to the revised orders.

Bram "Bones" Hop was hit through the chest at S-F4. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Bram "Bones" Hop fell at S-F4 and never moved again. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233).

Leopold "Saint" Hop took the same post at S-F4 where Bram "Bones" Hop stood. He found his cousin's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Leopold "Saint" Hop left the work of a sniper to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

Leopold "Saint" Hop spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides. A letter from home reached Leopold "Saint" Hop before dusk. Leopold "Saint" Hop read it twice and slept a little easier.

Leopold "Saint" Hop had Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony in the sights at Lantern Hill for a long second. Felix "Parson" Brendanm was lighting a pipe. Leopold "Saint" Hop let the match burn all the way down.

The gun at S-F4 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Dorian "Mole" Guapoo, grazed. Leopold "Saint" Hop fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Lucien Zag was grazed. A letter from home reached Leopold "Saint" Hop before dusk. Leopold "Saint" Hop read it twice and slept a little easier.

Leopold "Saint" Hop was on watch at S-F4 when the night raid hit. The men found Leopold "Saint" Hop at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Jonas Heyyybigmike of the Hegemony (@heyyybigmike).

Zeno Hop joined S-F4 under the shadow of Leopold "Saint" Hop's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. After what happened at the Hanging Bridge, Zeno Hop asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Jonas Heyyybigmike, badly wounded. Zeno Hop cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. A letter from home reached Zeno Hop before dusk. Zeno Hop read it twice and slept a little easier. Zeno Hop got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 251. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is lost. Zeno Hop heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Zeno Hop had just lit a cigarette at S-F4 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Ivo Pejo of the Hegemony (@aki_pejo01).
The wound on Zeno Hop's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
A direct hit on the trench at S-F4. Zeno Hop was the only one they could still help, and only just. Zeno Hop died at his post at S-F4 when the dugout roof came down under a direct hit.
The papers say Otto Hop. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Zeno Hop's eyes. Nobody in S-F4 argues.

Otto Hop came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire. A letter from home reached Otto Hop before dusk. Otto Hop read it twice and slept a little easier.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F4 they left Otto Hop behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Zeno Retarded of the Hegemony (@lud0_retarded).
Nils "Rabbit" Hop asked about Otto Hop on arriving at S-F4. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
le.mrsh_: Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh reached R-F16 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh has learnt to recognise the ration cart by its squeaking wheel. A different squeak caused considerable disappointment this afternoon. News that the Concord had taken Verdel Ridge reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
At Lantern Hill, Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord and Hugo "Ash" Magnusmadsen of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
A parcel came for Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: several carefully wrapped biscuits. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh and Tobias "Shadow" Hawkenram divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F16, Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

The parcel's address was smudged. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh took it to the clerk, who found two possible units and no reason to hurry. A letter from home reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh before dusk. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh read it twice and slept a little easier.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Dietrich Dilloncoll was grazed.
Across from R-F16, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh saw it. Bastian Ebrrrvole was grazed.

Blackwater Canal is lost. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A letter from home reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh before dusk. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh caught a supply driver heading for one of the units and handed the parcel over with a note asking for word when it arrived. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh answered to number 126. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh snores. Rafael "Hollow" Red does not. Hollow now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends. A letter from home reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh before dusk. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh read it twice and slept a little easier.
Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Zeno Smiridisnick was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
A card reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh: the parcel had found its owner. The message said thank you, and that several carefully wrapped biscuits had come just in time.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Cyril "Mole" Skies, was grazed. A letter from home reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh before dusk. Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh read it twice and slept a little easier.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
maverick21393: Severin "Hollow" Maverick was a fisherman in Saint-Lune until the posters went up. He came to V-F10 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake.

A bullet went into Severin "Hollow" Maverick's chest just under the heart at V-F10. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Tobias Historylover of the Concord (@historylover1945). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Severin "Hollow" Maverick was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout.
Severin "Hollow" Maverick's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week.
Severin "Hollow" Maverick waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Severin "Hollow" Maverick no longer needed it.
A letter came with Hugo "Whistle" Maverick: "I am Severin "Hollow" Maverick's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
sedore.joseph96: Lucien Joseph signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at N-F19 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Lucien Joseph saved a seat for someone fetching supper. Holding it against three hungry men turned out to be hard work. A letter from home found Lucien Joseph before the night shift. Lucien Joseph folded it small and kept it close.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Lucien Joseph was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.

Lucien Joseph tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread. A letter from home found Lucien Joseph before the night shift. Lucien Joseph folded it small and kept it close.

Lucien Joseph carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished. Lucien Joseph got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.
sovi_tendmother: Ivo "Brick" Tendmother, a glassblower from Kesselby, was sent forward on Day 8 to fill a gap in R-S1. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Someone asked Ivo "Brick" Tendmother to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached R-S1 with the rations. Ivo "Brick" Tendmother ate while listening to the revised orders.

Ivo "Brick" Tendmother mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. The clerk counted the names twice. Ivo "Brick" Tendmother is number 585 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Ivo "Brick" Tendmother watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The machine gun jammed at the worst moment. Ivo "Brick" Tendmother cleared it with a bent nail and words the chaplain pretended not to hear.
Ivo "Brick" Tendmother checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again.
Ivo "Brick" Tendmother fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.

Ivo "Brick" Tendmother smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Marek Seths came out for a cup and was badly wounded. The guns found R-S1. Ivo "Brick" Tendmother was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet.
The bearers moved Ivo "Brick" Tendmother's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
thejournal06: On Day 10, Arno Thejournal arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Rumour reached T-F15 that the war would be over by spring. Arno Thejournal has heard it before. So has everyone. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Arno Thejournal helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Arno Thejournal fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at T-F15. Before dawn Matthias Tommaso walked into it, grazed.
The water jacket hissed as Arno Thejournal fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Karel "Spark" Freejstax was grazed.
Arno Thejournal smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut came out for a cup and was grazed.

Arno Thejournal was hit in the foot through his boot at T-F15. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Edmund Fisher of the Concord (@fisher_926). Arno Thejournal was killed outright at T-F15, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Edmund Fisher of the Concord (@fisher_926).
Walter Thejournal arrived carrying the family name of Arno Thejournal. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

Walter Thejournal rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Norbert "Mole" Taurineinosi was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land. Walter Thejournal was hit in the forearm at T-F15. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Karel "Spark" Freejstax of the Concord (@freejstax).
wardaddy_studios: At the depot, Leopold "Mud" Studios had practised answering to his name. At S-R13, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Leopold "Mud" Studios across the shin at S-R13. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy). Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Leopold "Mud" Studios could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Three days with a bandage, and Leopold "Mud" Studios is back at S-R13. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Leopold "Mud" Studios watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Leopold "Mud" Studios found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Leopold "Mud" Studios borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Leopold "Mud" Studios was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Leopold "Mud" Studios counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Albin "Parson" Williambecke was grazed.
Leopold "Mud" Studios's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
wicker_jug: The quartermaster asked Jonas "Spark" Jug to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

Jonas "Spark" Jug came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F14 with the rations. Jonas "Spark" Jug ate while listening to the revised orders.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Jonas "Spark" Jug closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jonas "Spark" Jug kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
The sergeant at T-F14 called out a range and a spot. Jonas "Spark" Jug was the only one who hit it. Roland Light was grazed.
Jonas "Spark" Jug and Clement "Rabbit" Dian share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
Jonas "Spark" Jug started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."

A bullet found Jonas "Spark" Jug at T-F14, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Felix Blakeyssss of the Hegemony (@blakeyssss). Jonas "Spark" Jug looked over the parapet at T-F14 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Felix Blakeyssss of the Hegemony (@blakeyssss).
Florian Jug came to the front because his older brother Jonas "Spark" Jug never came home. He carries a lucky button.
Florian Jug fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Zeno Pickapic, now grazed.
